events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary actor and comedian John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Comedy Icon
angles.copy: Happy 87th Birthday to the one and only John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, he's given us some of the most iconic comedy moments in history. What's your favourite Cleese character or sketch?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' ninth studio album, officially titled 'The Beatles' but widely known as 'The White Album', was released on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Legacy
angles.copy: 58 years ago today, The Beatles unleashed their self-titled double album, forever known as 'The White Album'. A sprawling masterpiece that showed the band at their most experimental and diverse. What's your standout track?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury, 35 years on
events.blurb: Today marks 35 years since the passing of Queen frontman, Freddie Mercury, who died in 1991 at the age of 45.

angles.name: Legendary Voice
angles.copy: 35 years ago today, the world lost a true icon. Remembering the incomparable Freddie Mercury, whose voice and stage presence continue to inspire. What's your favourite Queen anthem?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their sixth studio album, 'Rubber Soul', on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Impact
angles.copy: On this day in 1965, The Beatles dropped 'Rubber Soul', an album that pushed boundaries and showcased their evolving sound. Which track from this classic still resonates with you?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon, 46 years on
events.blurb: Today marks 46 years since the tragic death of music legend John Lennon, who would have been 86 this year.

angles.name: Imagine Peace
angles.copy: 46 years since we lost John Lennon, a visionary artist and peace activist. His music and message continue to inspire generations worldwide. What's your favourite Lennon song?

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: Remembering the iconic David Bowie, who would have celebrated his 80th birthday today.

angles.name: Starman's Legacy
angles.copy: On what would have been his 80th birthday, we celebrate the enduring legacy of David Bowie. A true innovator who constantly reinvented music and style. What's your favourite Bowie era?

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: Remembering The King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, who would have celebrated his 92nd birthday today.

angles.name: Long Live The King
angles.copy: The King would have been 92 today! Join us in celebrating the birth of Elvis Presley, whose music changed the world forever. What's your ultimate Elvis track?

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Led Zeppelin guitarist and rock legend Jimmy Page celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: Happy 83rd Birthday to the iconic Jimmy Page! The Led Zeppelin mastermind who gave us some of rock's most unforgettable riffs. What's your favourite Page guitar moment?

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: Sir Rod Stewart, the legendary British singer with the distinctive raspy voice, celebrates his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: Forever Young
angles.copy: Happy 82nd Birthday to the one and only Rod Stewart! From the Faces to his incredible solo career, he's given us decades of timeless hits. What's your favourite Rod tune?

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Graham McPherson, better known as Suggs, the charismatic frontman of Madness, celebrates his 66th birthday today.

angles.name: Nutty Boy
angles.copy: Happy 66th Birthday to Suggs, the incomparable voice of Madness! From Camden Town to global stages, he's brought us a 'Baggy Trousers' full of hits. What's your favourite Madness moment?

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: English pop and blue-eyed soul singer Paul Young, known for hits like 'Wherever I Lay My Hat' and 'Every Time You Go Away', celebrates his 71st birthday today.

angles.name: Wherever He Lays His Hat
angles.copy: Happy 71st Birthday to the smooth voice of Paul Young! From 'Wherever I Lay My Hat' to 'Come Back and Stay', his hits defined an era. What's your top Paul Young track?

events.title: Dolly Parton turns 81
events.blurb: The legendary Queen of Country, Dolly Parton, celebrates her 81st birthday today.

angles.name: Queen of Country
angles.copy: Happy 81st Birthday to the one and only Dolly Parton! A true icon whose music, heart, and spirit shine brighter than any rhinestone. What's your favourite Dolly song?

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Take That frontman and acclaimed songwriter Gary Barlow celebrates his 56th birthday today.

angles.name: Take That Leader
angles.copy: Happy 56th Birthday to Gary Barlow! The musical force behind Take That and a brilliant solo artist. Which of his songs is your ultimate singalong?

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: Trinidadian-British singer-songwriter Billy Ocean, known for his string of 80s hits, celebrates his 77th birthday today.

angles.name: Caribbean Queen
angles.copy: Happy 77th Birthday to the smooth sounds of Billy Ocean! From 'Caribbean Queen' to 'When the Going Gets Tough', his music always makes us feel good. What's your favourite Billy Ocean hit?

events.title: Rock and Roll Hall Of Fame first induction anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1986, the first ever induction ceremony for the Rock and Roll Hall Of Fame was held, honouring pioneers like Elvis Presley, Chuck Berry, and James Brown.

angles.name: Hall of Fame Beginnings
angles.copy: 31 years ago today, rock history was made with the first Rock and Roll Hall Of Fame induction. Imagine that inaugural class: Elvis, Chuck Berry, James Brown! Who do you think was the most deserving of that first honour?

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: Take That singer-songwriter Mark Owen celebrates his 55th birthday today.

angles.name: Take That Heartthrob
angles.copy: Happy 55th Birthday to Mark Owen! The Take That star with a voice that's charmed millions. What's your favourite Mark Owen moment, solo or with the band?

events.title: The Beatles' Rooftop Concert anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1969, The Beatles performed their legendary final public concert on the rooftop of Apple Corps headquarters in London.

angles.name: Rooftop Rockers
angles.copy: 58 years ago today, The Beatles took to the roof for their iconic final live performance. What a way to go out! If you could have been there, what song would you have loved to hear live?

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: Grammy and Oscar-winning musician, singer, and songwriter Phil Collins celebrates his 76th birthday today.

angles.name: In The Air Tonight
angles.copy: Happy 76th Birthday to the legendary Phil Collins! From Genesis to his incredible solo career, his drumming and vocals are unmistakable. What's your favourite Phil Collins track?

events.title: Justin Timberlake turns 46
events.blurb: Award-winning singer, songwriter, and actor Justin Timberlake celebrates his 46th birthday today.

angles.name: Prince of Pop
angles.copy: Happy 46th Birthday to the multi-talented Justin Timberlake! From *NSYNC to solo superstardom, he's redefined pop music. What's your favourite JT song?

events.title: David Jason turns 87
events.blurb: Beloved British actor Sir David Jason, famous for his roles as Del Boy and Detective Jack Frost, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Lovely Jubbly
angles.copy: Happy 87th Birthday to the national treasure, Sir David Jason! Whether he's selling dodgy goods or solving crimes, he's always a joy to watch. What's your favourite David Jason character?

events.title: Anniversary of 'The Day The Music Died'
events.blurb: Today marks the 68th anniversary of 'The Day The Music Died', when rock and roll stars Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper died in a plane crash in 1959.

angles.name: A Tragic Day
angles.copy: 68 years ago today, music lost three incredible talents in 'The Day The Music Died'. Remembering Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper, whose influence lives on. What's your favourite track from these legends?

events.title: Rick Astley turns 61
events.blurb: English singer-songwriter Rick Astley, known for his 80s pop hits and his internet resurgence, celebrates his 61st birthday today.

angles.name: Never Gonna Give You Up
angles.copy: Happy 61st Birthday to the one and only Rick Astley! From chart-topper to internet sensation, his voice is unforgettable. What's your favourite Rick Astley track?

events.title: Bob Marley would have been 82
events.blurb: Today we remember reggae icon Bob Marley, who would have celebrated his 82nd birthday.

angles.name: One Love
angles.copy: On what would have been his 82nd birthday, we celebrate the enduring spirit and music of Bob Marley. His message of peace and unity still resonates globally. What's your favourite Bob Marley song?

events.title: Carole King turns 85
events.blurb: Legendary singer-songwriter Carole King, whose album 'Tapestry' is one of the best-selling of all time, celebrates her 85th birthday today.

angles.name: Tapestry of Hits
angles.copy: Happy 85th Birthday to the incredible Carole King! A songwriting genius who gave us a 'Tapestry' of unforgettable hits. What's your favourite song penned by Carole King?

events.title: Remembering Whitney Houston, 15 years on
events.blurb: Today marks 15 years since the passing of 'The Voice', Whitney Houston, who would have been 64 this year.

angles.name: The Voice
angles.copy: 15 years ago today, we lost the legendary Whitney Houston. Her unparalleled voice and powerful performances continue to move us. What's your favourite Whitney ballad?

events.title: Anniversary of Take That's original split
events.blurb: On this day in 1996, the original Take That lineup announced their split, leaving millions of fans heartbroken.

angles.name: Never Forget
angles.copy: Remember the day the music stopped? 29 years ago today, Take That announced their split, breaking hearts across the nation. Thankfully, they came back stronger! What was your reaction to the news back then?
